verdict.rationale: Unity ships a well-documented official CLI for the Editor and Player, supporting batch/headless mode, custom arguments, and automated build workflows (unity-docs-6/7/8/9, unity-probe-5), which is exactly the kind of scriptable interface an AI agent could drive for CI/automation. Missing for 10: no AI-specific CLI tooling and the docs aren't machine-readable (llms.txt/.md mirrors 404 per unity-probe-rt-2), limiting direct agent ingestion of the CLI reference itself.
